description: Search leave requests by employee, location, status and time window. Status: 0 awaiting approval, 1 approved, 2 declined, 3 cancelled, 4 date approved without pay, 5 pay approved without date. Start/End are unix; LeaveRule is the leave type id. Deputy: POST /api/v1/resource/Leave/QUERY.

from.description: Only leave starting at or after this time: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 date/datetime (include an offset for local times).

location_id.description: Only leave against this location (Company id).

start.description: Pagination offset (0-based). Pass the previous page's next_start.

to.description: Only leave starting at or before this time: a unix timestamp in seconds, or an ISO 8601 date/datetime (include an offset for local times).

name: deputy_list_leave
title: List leave requests
